title: edge-aware fleet latency pacer and tenant burst harmonizer
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Introduces edge-aware pacing for fleet request routing and a tenant-level burst harmonizer that reduces latency spikes during cross-region contention. Configurable via FleetAutoscaler (opt-in).
description: Context: We frequently see short-lived latency spikes when traffic shifts between edge regions (e.g., failover, sudden regional load) that temporarily starve tenant warm credits in some pools. Motivation: Reduce 95th/99th latency tail in multi-pool deployments without globally reducing throughput. Solution summary: 1) Introduce an edge-aware latency pacer that computes region-level pacing allowances using a decayed percentile of recent p99/p95 latency and pool occupancy; 2) Add a tenant burst harmonizer that smooths burst credit consumption across pools by applying a small integral/differential correction to tenant credit drains; 3) Emit telemetry for new metrics (edge_pacer_p95_ms, edge_pacer_allowed_rps, tenant_harmonizer_integral, tenant_harmonizer_damping) so we can tune online; 4) Make feature opt-in via FleetAutoscalerSpec.EdgePacerConfig to allow staged rollout. Design details: The pacer runs in the fleet controlplane and maintains a sliding window histogram per-region (60s window, 1s buckets) to compute p95/p99. We convert percentile -> pacing factor using a sigmoid mapping to avoid hard clamps. Pacing factor modulates per-pool admission tokens and a fast-path latency budget. The tenant harmonizer lives in the slot allocator and adjusts per-tenant soft-burst drain rate using a PID-like controller with conservative defaults. Safety: If pacer detects >10% request rejections or increased queueing it backs off to legacy behavior for that tenant/region and emits an alert telemetry tag. Rollout plan: 1) Canary on a single non-critical cluster (edge region eu-west-2) with pilot tenants; 2) Collect edge_pacer_p95_ms and tenant_harmonizer_integral for 24h; 3) Gradually expand to more pools if no regressions. Metrics and alerts to watch: - edge_pacer_p95_ms (per-region) - tenant_burst_credit_balance (per-tenant) - tenant_harmonizer_integral (per-tenant) - request_queue_depth (per-pool) Backwards compatibility & opt-in: Default config is disabled; FleetAutoscaler CRD has new optional block EdgePacerConfig and HarmonizerConfig. There are no schema-breaking changes when omitted. Testing & validation: Unit tests for pacer mapping function and harmonizer integrator; integration tests that simulate cross-region traffic shifts; a perf harness run showing p95 improvement of 10-18% in synthetic failover scenarios. Checklist: - [x] Add FleetAutoscaler CRD fields and validators - [x] Implement pacer in fleet controlplane - [x] Implement harmonizer in slot allocator - [x] Add telemetry + dashboards (Grafana rows added) - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Perf harness run (benchmark lab) - [x] Documentation snippets (console + CLI) Related: ENG-5374 (capability request), ENG-5401 (pilot telemetry), PR 331415 (headroom calibrator) Merge strategy: squash and merge with a short commit message referencing the Linear tickets.
